1.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_010
1.description: <beep> Awakening from sleep mode. Awaiting orders.

5.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_A1_000_022
5.description: Request to keep your aetherpool gear.

9.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_030
9.description: <bzzzt> Request denied. By Archmagus Noah's orders, aetherpool equipment must not be taken from the premises until she has given explicit approval.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_SYSTEM_000_031
10.description: You must first clear floor 30 and complete the subsequent quest in order to use aetherpool gear outside of Eureka Orthos.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_040
11.description: <blip> <buzz> Functionality not yet implemented. Continue current task until upgrade is complete.

12.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_SYSTEM_000_041
12.description: You must first clear floor 30 of Eureka Orthos and complete the subsequent quest in order to synthesize an Orthos aetherpool grip.

13.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_050
13.description: Aether absorbed in battle may be used to stabilize aetherpool arms. However, the current amount of aether present in your equipment is insufficient for the operation.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_SYSTEM_000_051
14.description: In order to forge an aetherpool grip, both your aetherpool weapon and armor must have attained a minimum strength of +10.

15.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_052
15.description: <blip> <buzz> Large quantities of aether detected in equipment. Amount deemed sufficient to synthesize aetherpool grip.

16.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_Q2_000_053
16.description: Synthesize an Orthos aetherpool grip?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>※The strength of your aetherpool arm and armor will be reduced by 10.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

18.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_A3_000_061
18.description: What is there to be found in the laboratory?

19.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_A3_000_062
19.description: Can aetherpool arms be used outside of the laboratory?

21.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_070
21.description: Mistress Noah has created me for the sole purpose of synthesizing the resources found within Eureka Orthos. I am grateful for the role she has given me.

22.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_071
22.description: Place any discarded experiments within me, and I will reconfigure them into something of use. Do not worry about organizing them beforehand─all matter is the same to me.

23.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_080
23.description: The aetherpool equipment forged by Mistress Noah is imbued with wards that counteract Eureka Orthos's enervating magicks.

24.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_DD3ITEMSHOP_000_081
24.description: However, these very same wards cause the equipment to become unstable without an opposing force, and aetherpool grips are required to make up for this deficiency.

25.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_SYSTEM_000_082
25.description: To use your Orthos aetherpool weapon outside of Eureka Orthos, you must first forge Orthos aetherpool grips.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_SYSTEM_000_083
26.description: Forging one grip will reduce the strength of your Orthos aetherpool arm and armor by 10.

27.name: TEXT_CTSDDD3REWARD_00819_SYSTEM_000_084
27.description: You must first clear floor 30 of Eureka Orthos and complete the subsequent quest in order to forge an Orthos aetherpool grip.
